sentences.text: This {stage} {sex} green turtle was tagged at {release_site} and tracked for {days_tracked}: {species_rank_days}.
Adult green turtles graze mainly on seagrass and algae.
She stayed relatively close: her farthest position, on {farthest_date}, was {max_displacement_km} from where tracking began.
Her deepest recorded dive was {deepest_dive_m}, and her longest lasted {longest_dive_min}.
